headline: @poetikflakkonews: #NBA veteran #HarrisonBarnes has purchased Community State Bank in Paton, Iowa...
body: #NBA veteran #HarrisonBarnes has purchased Community State Bank in Paton, Iowa, through his company Barnes Bancorp, Inc. 🏦💰 The 34-year-old Iowa native has long been interested in community banking and even attended the Iowa School of Banking while playing in the NBA. The bank will keep its name, employees, and management team, while Barnes looks to reinvest in his home state. A recent SEC filing also lists a proposed $25 million equity offering. 💼📈🔥👀 • @sammmyy_10
caption:
#NBA veteran #HarrisonBarnes has purchased Community State Bank in Paton, Iowa, through his company Barnes Bancorp, Inc. 🏦💰 The 34-year-old Iowa native has long been interested in community banking and even attended the Iowa School of Banking while playing in the NBA. The bank will keep its name, employees, and management team, while Barnes looks to reinvest in his home state. A recent SEC filing also lists a proposed $25 million equity offering. 💼📈🔥👀 • @sammmyy_10
